item.title: LOVB Houston kicks off year two with tremendous buzz; expectations
item.description: LOVB Houston is gearing up for another exciting season, opening January 8 at the Berry Center against Salt Lakewith first serve set for 7 p.m.VYPE’s Matt Malatesta caught up with two of Houston’s stars — Madi Kingdon and Amber Igiede — as they prepare for the league’s second season and another run in front of the home crowd.Check out the full podcast.
